مقدمة

This document 
outlines the equipment inspection I1 which must be performed every year as 
indicated by Y1 in the title block.
The technical specification of the unit generator:

The first draft was initiated by eng. Hussein Hashem Mohamed, tested by eng. 
Naser El Sayed Abd EL-Aziz, accepted by general director eng. Mohamed Osama 
Soliman Selim, approved by eng. Mohamed Abdel-Baset head sector of Aswan 
Dam (1&2) power stations and certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem HPGC MPIS 
coordinatori and inspection & quality control general director.
احتياطات السلامة

يجب إصدار تصريح عمل، والصيانة المؤهلة 
 يجب أن يحمل الموظفون فئة السلامة المناسبة.
مطلوب سياج أمان مع علامات تحذير تحيط بمنطقة العمل.

Wear your safety equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, breathing mask, safety glass ... 
 etc
Put the generator out of service
The generator circuit breaker is switched off
تم إيقاف تشغيل قاطع مجال المولد
The bus duct equipment are earthed
The brake is applied manually for the rotating parts of the generator
The CO2 extinguishers system is isolated
